Working color space

Definition

Working color space is the chosen color representation in which grading, compositing or image calculations are performed. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align color decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
